proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Amend bylaws to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes it is important that shareholders have a meaningful right to call special shareholder meetings, a right that ExxonMobil currently provides.
